name: mullans-engineering
description: Engineering skills for repository work, plan execution, and the research documentation lifecycle.

interface.shortDescription: Support repository work and research continuity.
interface.longDescription: Reusable workflows for repository agent efficiency, approved plan execution, research setup, handoffs, finding promotion, and reference maintenance.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Efficiency Setup to improve this repository's agent workflow.
Use Make It So to implement the approved plan in this conversation.
Use Research Setup to establish this research workspace.
Use Research Handoff to prepare this work for the next session.
Use Research Promotion to codify supported findings from this session.
Use Maintain Research Docs to review reference organization.
